URTH.source: iShares fact sheet (as of 2026-09-30); stockanalysis.com page returned stale data dated 2026-08-24

macro_events: Democrats won control of both the House and Senate in the midterms, easing election uncertainty but raising worries about AI and data center scrutiny; Trump said he would veto Democratic legislation
ADP private payrolls rose 86,000 in October (est. 75,000); October jobs report due Friday Nov 6 and CPI on Nov 10, with futures pricing about 81% odds of a Fed hike in December
Oil fell about 2.6% as Iran war de-escalation hopes grew, though four tankers hit mines in the Strait of Hormuz; RBA raised rates on Tuesday

leading.reason: Mega-cap rebound (Microsoft, Apple, Alphabet up 5% to 7%) as AMD beat earnings; approximate, based on Nasdaq and stock moves
Hospitals and insurers (HCA, Centene up 5% to 7%) on expected Medicaid and policy changes under a Democratic Congress; approximate

lagging.reason: Crude down about 2.6% on Iran de-escalation hopes and defense names softer; approximate
Defensive group lagging the risk-on rally after hitting a record high; approximate

open_focus: Traders are focused on the relief rally after Democrats won Congress, whether the AI and chip rebound holds amid regulation worries, and Friday's October jobs report ahead of a possible December Fed hike.
